metadata.title: New Jack Swing Era Album Aesthetic

retrievalProfile.description: Produces a high-contrast studio portrait featuring subjects in formal white attire against a warm, textured earth-tone backdrop with vertical and circular graphic overlays.

recipe.visualDefinition: A dual-subject studio portrait characterized by sharp, directional lighting that creates deep shadows, featuring subjects in crisp white suits against a mottled, warm-toned wall. The composition is framed by vertical sans-serif text on the left and a vibrant, multi-layered circular emblem in the bottom right.
coreVisualRelationships: High-key white garments against low-key warm backgrounds
Vertical text alignment balancing a circular graphic element
Sharp directional lighting creating hard shadows on the backdrop
coreInvariants: Strong side-lighting with visible cast shadows

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two subjects positioned centrally and slightly offset, filling the middle two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright white suits serve as the primary anchor, with the colorful circular logo in the bottom right acting as a secondary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the vertical text on the left, across the subjects' faces, down to the circular graphic in the lower right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep shadows on the left and the textured wall provide a sense of depth and contrast.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant yellow, green, and red (graphic elements)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between subjects and background; high saturation reserved for graphic overlays.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters in the vertical title are widely spaced and horizontally stretched
Numbers in the logo are stylized with thick, horizontal speed-line cuts
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast a vertically stacked title with a circular, arched subtitle surrounding a central numeric logo.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the wide, square-ish geometric feel of the era's display type.
Provides the necessary weight for the arched text if condensed slightly.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A studio portrait of two people in formal white 90s-style suits against a warm, mottled brown textured wall with strong directional lighting from the right casting shadows on the left.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a vertical title on the far left with wide-stretched yellow-gradient letters. In the bottom right, add a circular emblem featuring a yellow sunburst, green inner circle, and red arched text.

verificationChecks: Is the text vertically stacked on the left?
Are the suits bright white against a warm background?
Is there a circular graphic in the bottom right corner?
Does the lighting create a distinct shadow on the backdrop?

postGenerationChecks: Check for high-contrast shadows on the wall
Ensure text is horizontally stretched as per the 90s aesthetic
Verify the circular graphic does not obscure the subjects' faces
Confirm the warm/cool balance (warm background, cool white clothing)
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio Portrait + White Formalwear + Warm Mottled Backdrop + Vertical Stretched Typography + Circular Emblem Overlay
